CustomField.description: The developer name of the Account record type whose accounts are organizations, or Master for no record type (canonical model R-O4, ADR-0141). Detected and stored on install and source deploy when blank, never overwritten there. Text because a custom setting field cannot be a picklist (ADR-0019).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose it in BarnCRM Settings, General, Record type for organizations.
CustomField.label: Organization Record Type
